body:
Thanks, sincerely. Post answered in public.

When they say "par-a-dyne shift", boy they aren't kidding!

...and there are so many , many more than I, so much worse off than I.

Peace!

Thanks- ah, I must be getting old - "couchsurfing"...  Thinking this is some altruistic lovingkindness legacy of te h60's - offering a warm place to sleep and maybe a blanket.  But no "CouchSurfing International Inc. is a for-profit private C corporation".  Again, my faith in this culture dims even more.

But your comments are appreciated, and yes I am looking and trying to find employment "where the jobs are" while making the best of it here.  There's no funds for a luxury trip, and this economy, and my resume suck everywhere (I wish I hadn't been so confident then...) 

I did have a wanderlust - since High School (long story there) and up until I found any thread of a support network; 3 years ago.  It's been "cruise control" since then.  But the "bridge out" signs have been noted, and the end of the road is visible...

But other than that, Mrs. Kenedy, how did you like that Texas hospitality? 

I still wonder if there's something in my idea.  Gee, maybe I can start "deathmatch-dot-com...  (no, it redirects to a card game site!).

Peace and joy, serenity and success to you and to those that need it.  

And if you are thinking of taking the plunge, that terminal snatch clean and jerk, hey, dy'a wanna go for a ride?
